churn_resistance.rationale: Good structural choices (single data-access module, standard adapter layout, no framework internals, v2-affected identifiers confined to entry/config files), but the external API boundary is untyped (any), domain constants and label-fallback logic are duplicated across loaders, and build outputs are not gitignored.

findings.issue: Almost all internal navigation uses raw <a> (pokemon cards, move/type links, evolution tree, pagination) while layout.tsx uses Link, so every in-app click is a full page reload with no Qwik prefetching.
findings.suggestion: Use Qwik City's Link component for all internal links (import from '@builder.io/qwik-city') to get SPA navigation and prefetch; keep raw <a> only for external URLs.

findings.issue: The entire PokeAPI payload surface is typed as Promise<any>, so API schema drift surfaces as runtime rendering bugs rather than type errors.
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the PokeAPI payloads (NamedAPIResource, Pokemon, Move, Type, Generation…) and have apiGet return typed results, keeping the internal views (TypeInfo, CardData, MoveRow) as the stable boundary.

findings.issue: Unbounded in-memory Map cache with no eviction or TTL; ~1000 species records plus ~900 move records (some ~100KB with full move lists) can accumulate to hundreds of MB per process.
findings.suggestion: Cap the cache (LRU or size limit) and/or expire entries after a TTL, keeping the promise-deduplication behavior.

findings.issue: Outbound fetches have no timeout or AbortSignal, so a hung API request stalls the SSR response indefinitely.
findings.suggestion: Pass { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000) } (Node 24 supports it natively) to fetch and treat aborts like failures.

findings.issue: app/dist/ and app/server/ (generated build output, currently in the worktree) are not gitignored; the standard Qwik starter ignores /dist, /server and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, so a naive 'git add app' would commit bundles.
findings.suggestion: Add app/.gitignore with /dist, /server, node_modules, and *.tsbuildinfo (tsconfig has incremental: true).

findings.issue: EXCLUDED_TYPES is defined twice (also lib/api.ts:86), and the 'label fallback to humanize' logic is re-implemented in three loaders.
findings.suggestion: Export the exclusion set and a shared labelFor() helper from lib/api.ts and reuse it in the route loaders.

findings.issue: Static root serves all of dist/ with 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable', which also applies to non-fingerprinted files (404.html, sitemap.xml, q-manifest.json).
findings.suggestion: Serve the immutable cache-control only for hashed asset paths (or narrow the static root to the assets directory) and use a short/no-cache header for the rest.

findings.issue: Unmatched URLs are handled by a hand-rolled [...all] catch-all route with a routeLoader$ that calls status(404), rather than the documented 404.tsx route convention (which is statically generated as 404.html and gets 404 status for free).
findings.suggestion: Keep the documented dynamic-404 pattern for known routes, but move the catch-all rendering to a src/routes/404.tsx file.

findings.issue: Magic stat-bar scale factors (255 for individual stats, 780 for the total) are inlined in the template, making a future rescaling rule a template edit.
findings.suggestion: Lift MAX_STAT / MAX_TOTAL into named constants (or compute in the loader) so the display rule lives in one place.

summary: This is a lean, current-generation Qwik City app: it pins the framework's exact latest stable (1.20.3), uses only modern primitives (routeLoader$, useSignal, useNavigate, dynamic-404 status()), and carries just two runtime dependencies. The main forward-looking weaknesses are the pervasive use of raw <a> instead of Link (losing SPA navigation and prefetching), an untyped external API boundary backed by an unbounded in-memory cache, and missing gitignore entries for build output. A Qwik v2 upgrade would be low-touch since the renamed identifiers are confined to four entry/config files, but the raw-anchor habit and weak boundary typing should be fixed before they calcify.
